flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-23, Region 4 Kootenay.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-23, Region 4 Kootenay.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-23: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).
